title: If you see a flatbed tow truck in the mall, it was me
content: I hijacked a beat up flat bed style tow truck and drove it into the mall. I was not destructive, I drove carefully through the large main doors, up the main stairs and down the concourse level about 300 yards. I drove slow, didn't run anyone over and everyone got out of the way for me. No one really seems that concerned with what I was doing. I parked and abandoned the truck right in the middle of a shopping/retail section of the mall, right in the pedestrian walkway connecting the main entrance to the atrium. I then met up with some family members and we wondered off on an adventure to the airport. I want to know if anyone saw this tow truck, either driving or parked, it would be something that really looks out of place in a mall setting. I'm going to try to keep bringing things into the mall world that don't belong and see if anyone notices. &#x200B; &#x200B;
